column1: # Ground truth for scoring analyze_track.py.  path <TAB> bpm <TAB> key
# PROVISIONAL. Every value below is Echo Nest / Spotify-derived (tunebat,
# songbpm, getsongbpm, musicstax are all re-displays of that one pipeline, not
# independent sources). It therefore carries the SAME octave-error risk this
# fixture exists to measure -- treat a disagreement here as a question, not a
# verdict. Two entries are already known-suspect:
#   - Rambo 181: an extreme outlier for a slow trap track; likely a double-time
#     read of ~90. Our detector says 89.7.
#   - Nikes 137: a ~68.5 halftime pocket is standard for this production style.
# Replace a row with a hand-tapped value and drop the `?` suffix once verified
# by ear. Rows whose bpm ends in `?` are excluded from the strict score.
# Blank bpm or key = unknown, skipped for that metric.
